# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260415T153524Z-api_algo_variants_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 1855e2554d7de3ae.
# Replays the IB algo variant matrix (AORD-003) captured on 2026-04-15 against
# live paper Gateway: thirteen algo strategies, each placed as a far-from-market
# LMT BUY 1 AAPL (delayed-quote anchor 262.98 / 20 = 13.15). Seven were
# accepted and rested until cancelled (order_status Cancelled plus the code-202
# notice): Adaptive/Urgent 262 and AD 268 via PreSubmitted, Adaptive/Patient
# 263, Vwap 265, ArrivalPx 266, ClosePx 270, and PctVol 271 straight to
# Submitted. Six were rejected at place time with no order_status: Twap 264
# code 443 "Unknown algo attribute:strategyType", DarkIce 267 (placed with
# display size 1, as DarkIce requires in reference clients) code 10255 "The
# 'Display Size' order attribute may not be specified for this order.",
# and Inline 269, BalanceImpactRisk 272, MinImpact 273, JefAD 274 each code
# 439 "Algorithm definition not found". Rejected placements still consumed
# their order ids (262..274, no reuse), and the follow-up API cancel for the
# rejected DarkIce id 267 drew no response at all. The Gateway's open_order
# echoes reorder algo params, convert the client's UTC start/end times to
# US/Eastern, and append server-side params the client never sent (Vwap grows
# optoutClosingAuction/speedUp/optoutOpeningAuction on the second echo, PctVol
# grows includeBlockTrades, AD replaces startTime/endTime with
# activeTimeStart/activeTimeEnd).
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900<order id>, order refs -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260415T153525Z-NNN,
# in the two raw live-layout frames also inside the composite perm/account key
# and with the submitter username blanked; all other values are verbatim.
# Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the driver's startup and final safety
# global cancels, the delayed-quote anchor exchange (market-data-type toggles,
# the req 1/2 tick stream, and the code-10168 entitlement notice), and the
# trailing executions query, which timed out client-side live; its late
# response frames carried earlier scenarios' executions only (every algo order
# here cancelled unfilled).
